title: Income-tax Act — Section 24 (Deductions from house property income)

content.overview: Section 24 allows the statutory deduction and the deduction for interest on borrowed capital from house-property income.
content.glance: Section 24 allows the statutory deduction and the deduction for interest on borrowed capital from house-property income.
content.study: From the annual value, section 24 allows a deduction of thirty per cent of the annual value and a deduction for interest payable on capital borrowed for acquisition, construction, repair, renewal or reconstruction, subject to the self-occupied cap.
